title: JPARK
description: jpark.co Jenkongklai PCL, known as JPARK, is a Thai parking operator founded in 1998 by engineer Santipol Jenwattanaphaisarn and listed on the MAI exchange since October 2023. From its first lot at Sam Yan market it has grown to over 60 sites and 20000 to 28000 spaces in Bangkok and major provinces, including Siam Square, Chulalongkorn University, hospitals and MRTA park and ride facilities. Its three lines are own operated parking, 68 percent of revenue, contracted management, and consulting and installation of its PromptPark smart system with LPR cameras and cashless payment. It builds its own parking buildings, J Park Kanchanasuk opened 2024 and a 500 million baht Siriraj Salaya project with 1000 spaces opens 2026. FY2025 revenue was 576 million baht, net profit 83 million, founder Santipol holds 53 percent.
